metadata.evaluation_name: cold-start heuristic wide-screen (iteration-2, EXECUTED): survivor selection + confirm round
metadata.status: COMPLETE - screen executed on shared measurements; confirm round executed

run_preamble.bootstrap_reduction_note: B=3000 held for STEP 5 / STEP 10 headline CIs; reduced to 1500 for the noise report and seed sweep only, as pre-registered.

fixes_applied.F1: MERGE-ALL-PARTS loading via method_out_manifest.json (iteration-1 loaded only the first candidate/part)
fixes_applied.F2: POPULATE CATALOG META (iteration-1 set meta={} always, emptying HHI/attr_entropy/mean_hist/n_items)
fixes_applied.F3: plain-vs-banded uses n_items<=100 to reproduce the reviewer 98; both <100 and <=100 reported
fixes_applied.F4: MIN_USERS_CELL=50 guard excludes under-powered cells from statistical claims

coverage_report.split_protocol: Two-level split. Level-1 catalog fold: screen = 192 inline grid + 11 pool synthetic = 203 synthetic (fold 'screen'); confirm = 8 pool synthetic + 4 real (fold 'confirm'). Level-2 within-catalog user-log half: per-example metadata_fold ('screen' if the ground-truth purchase position <= floor(0.8L) else 'confirm'). The screen analysis uses Level-1-screen catalogs x screen user-log halves; the confirm round uses CONFIRM user-log halves of every catalog (the never-touched test set).
coverage_report.pool_files_not_in_215: The 3 shared-pool files the experiment SKIPPED (uci_retail_1.json, uci_retail_2.json, catalog_schema.json) are NOT among the 215: the two UCI full versions were skipped because their histories reference items outside their 1000-item universe (the _lights restricted variants are the usable forms); catalog_schema.json is a schema, not a catalog.

dynamic_rediscovery.note: re-discovery performed exactly once; any newly found real catalog would be added to the CONFIRM round with fold=confirm and would NEVER influence screen fitting or survivor selection (never waited on). None were found.

metric_definitions.primary: per-user NDCG@5 = 1/log2(r+1) if r<=5 else 0 (r 1-indexed rank of the true next item; single relevant item, ideal DCG=1)
metric_definitions.na_cells: content_knn_*, last_item_nbhd, pop_scaled_content, co_purchase undefined at k=0 (excluded, not a miss); active_elic2 defined only at k=0; lambda_hybrid_* at k=0 degenerate to (1-lambda)*normalized_popularity.

metadata.reference_definition: per catalog: best popularity-family heuristic (pop_global, banded pop_category/pop_price; NOT recency-windowed which is candidate D) by mean NDCG@5 over k in {0,1,2,3,5,8} on the SCREEN half

selection_decision.rule_trace: A candidate SURVIVES iff (i) median-over-catalogs screen gain >= +0.02 NDCG@5 AND its 95% CI excludes 0 in >= 50% of catalogs AND (ii) it is not dominated by another candidate under the same rule in >= 50% of catalogs. Multiple -> largest median gain; NONE of A,C,D -> NOISE (B) formally wins. Ties (CI straddling 0) are reported explicitly as ties.

noise_report_candidate_B.note: B measured directly: how often a pairwise median gain is within its 95% CI of 0, and the fraction of |gain| < 0.02 over (catalog, heuristic, k) pairs.

k8_gain_vs_n_items.expectation: expect k8 gain steeper/less-negative for LARGER |V| (rho>0)

k8_gain_vs_attr_entropy.expectation: expect k8 gain rises with attr entropy (rho>0)

k8_gain_vs_sales_hhi.expectation: expect k8 gain FALLS with sales HHI (rho<0)

slope_vs_attr_entropy.expectation: expect slope rises with attr entropy (rho>0)

slope_vs_sales_hhi.expectation: expect slope FALLS with sales HHI (rho<0)

continuous_surrogate.label: pre-registered continuous surrogate (content-family gain at k=8 and gain-vs-k slope) so the signed direction stays testable when k* is inf.

plain_vs_banded_smallest_le100.reviewer_target: iteration-1 claimed plain beats pop_category in 75/98 and pop_price in 73/98; recomputed exactly above with the MIN_USERS drop.

plain_vs_banded_smallest_lt100.reviewer_target: iteration-1 claimed plain beats pop_category in 75/98 and pop_price in 73/98; recomputed exactly above with the MIN_USERS drop.

phase_diagram.note: Expectation: POP -> banded -> content/hybrid ordering as catalogs grow. Verified directly whether this materializes within |V|<=1000 in this generative family (anticipated: it does NOT; content never overtakes).

classification.degenerate_note: positive class empty among the screen synthetic catalogs, so the +0.02 don't-build boundary is degenerate and the always-popularity (always predict don't-build) rule trivially achieves accuracy 1.0.

LOO_gain_over_baselines.degenerate_note: positive class empty (no screen synthetic catalog reaches headroom>=+0.02); boundary accuracy is the trivial always-don't-build floor of 1.0.

deployable_map.coding_note: high HHI + low norm-entropy -> pop_global; flat demand / high norm-entropy -> lambda_hybrid_0.5 or content_knn_3; middle -> banded popularity or lambda_hybrid_0.25. The empirical majority winners above instantiate the deployable map on the screen half.

decision_rule.position_note: This is a 2-3-stat mechanically-fit (depth<=2) rule over LIGHTWEIGHT heuristics, intentionally distinct from black-box meta-models over heavy algorithms in the meta-feature algorithm-selection line (Cunha 2018; Wegmeth RecSys 2024). The +0.02 gate appears in TWO roles without conflation: (STEP 5) the mechanical survivor threshold; (STEP 8, here) the classification boundary with its LOO accuracy.

secondary_plugin.note: plug-in upper bound with a coarse 'last purchase category' signature; estimable only for pool synthetic catalogs whose processed file is on disk; superseded by the generator MC ceiling where present.

mi_ceiling.caveat: Generator MC metadata_mi_ceiling (primary) is the ground-truth ceiling; it exists for the 192 inline synthetic catalogs. The plug-in estimator (secondary) is positively biased for small samples and is an UPPER BOUND / ceiling, not a target.

elicitation_gain_k0.note: active elicitation (2 forced-choice questions, documented answer noise 0.2) gain vs popularity at k=0; every cell uses the disclosed per-catalog seed.

turnover_corr.note: recency-windowed popularity best-window NDCG@5 gain vs the reference, split by the pool family_params dynamic_turnover flag. A turnover statistic is absent for the 192 inline grid catalogs (the grid has no dynamic/turnover dimension); the correlation uses only the pool synthetic families that carry the flag.

repro_gate.note: R1 compares recomputed (catalog, heuristic, k) metrics over BOTH user-log halves to out/aggregates_by_catalog_heuristic_k.csv (produced by the experiment over all users).
